select eic.id , eic.seller_name , eic.contract_code , is_auto_generation, process_status, CASE WHEN eic.is_auto_generation = '1' OR (eic.is_auto_generation ='0' AND eic.process_status = '1') THEN '是' ELSE '否' end as isInvoiced, eic.product_name , eic.invoice_number , eic.tax_value, eic.tax_rate, eic.create_time , COALESCE(SUM(ertd.tax_amount), 0) AS invoiceDetailTax from eg_invoice_claim eic left join eg_receive_tax_detail ertd on eic.contract_code =ertd.remark and eic.invoice_number =ertd.invoice_number and eic.product_name =ertd.product_name and ertd.del_flag = '0' where eic.del_flag = '0' and date_trunc('month', eic.create_time) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
and eic.id in
#{item}
GROUP BY eic.id, eic.seller_name, eic.contract_code, eic.is_auto_generation, eic.process_status, eic.product_name, eic.invoice_number, eic.tax_value, eic.create_time , eic.tax_rate order by eic.id desc
